name: a range arm matches below the first break
source:
tariff "t"
let w = 499 lb
let perCwt = match w {
  ..500 lb          => $42.00/cwt
  500 lb..2_000 lb  => $35.50/cwt
  2_000 lb..5_000 lb => $28.10/cwt
  _                 => $22.75/cwt
}
note "{perCwt}"

name: a range arm's lower bound is inclusive
source:
tariff "t"
let w = 500 lb
let perCwt = match w {
  ..500 lb          => $42.00/cwt
  500 lb..2_000 lb  => $35.50/cwt
  2_000 lb..5_000 lb => $28.10/cwt
  _                 => $22.75/cwt
}
note "{perCwt}"

name: range arms convert units
source:
tariff "t"
let w = 30 cwt
let perCwt = match w {
  ..500 lb          => $42.00/cwt
  500 lb..2_000 lb  => $35.50/cwt
  2_000 lb..5_000 lb => $28.10/cwt
  _                 => $22.75/cwt
}
note "{perCwt}"

name: the wildcard arm catches the rest
source:
tariff "t"
let w = 5_000 lb
let perCwt = match w {
  ..500 lb          => $42.00/cwt
  500 lb..2_000 lb  => $35.50/cwt
  2_000 lb..5_000 lb => $28.10/cwt
  _                 => $22.75/cwt
}
note "{perCwt}"

name: a closed range includes its end
source:
tariff "t"
let x = 5
let label = match x {
  1..=5 => "low"
  _ => "high"
}
note "{label}"

name: variants match
source:
tariff "t"
let k = Delivery
let label = match k {
  Pickup => "p"
  Delivery => "d"
  SplitPickup | SplitDelivery => "split"
}
note "{label}"

name: alternatives match either
source:
tariff "t"
let k = SplitDelivery
let label = match k {
  Pickup => "p"
  Delivery => "d"
  SplitPickup | SplitDelivery => "split"
}
note "{label}"

name: qualified variants match
source:
tariff "t"
let s = StopStatus.Completed
let label = match s {
  StopStatus.Completed => "done"
  _ => "open"
}
note "{label}"

name: none matches none
source:
tariff "t"
let w = shipment.weight
let label = match w {
  none => "none"
  _ => "some"
}
note "{label}"

name: a binding matches anything and binds it
source:
tariff "t"
let n = 7
let label = match n {
  0 => "zero"
  other => "{other}"
}
note "{label}"

name: a guard filters an arm
source:
tariff "t"
let n = 7
let label = match n {
  x if x > 5 => "big"
  _ => "small"
}
note "{label}"

name: a failing guard falls through
source:
tariff "t"
let n = 3
let label = match n {
  x if x > 5 => "big"
  _ => "small"
}
note "{label}"

name: record patterns match fields
record patterns reject a field
literal patterns compare across scales
source:
tariff "t"
let a = $426.00
let label = match a {
  $426 => "exact"
  _ => "other"
}
note "{label}"

name: text literal patterns
source:
tariff "t"
let c = "TX"
let label = match c {
  "TX" | "OK" => "south"
  _ => "elsewhere"
}
note "{label}"

name: bool patterns
source:
tariff "t"
let b = false
let label = match b {
  true => "yes"
  false => "no"
}
note "{label}"

name: negative literal patterns
source:
tariff "t"
let n = -1
let label = match n {
  -1 => "minus one"
  _ => "other"
}
note "{label}"

name: a match statement runs its arm's block
a match statement arm may be an expression
source:
tariff "t"
let n = 1
match n {
  1 => [1].len
  _ => 0
}
note "after"

name: match arm bindings stay in the arm
no arm covering a value is internal
date range patterns
percent range patterns
source:
tariff "t"
let p = 18%
let tier = match p {
  ..10% => "low"
  10%..=20% => "mid"
  _ => "high"
}
note "{tier}"
